The shipped config passes the budget check: the reserve is 47.00 and 60 covers it. I also updated test literals and comments that pinned the old 50.00, in config.rs, admission.rs, reading.rs, run_pin_tests.rs, run/tests.rs and crates/athena-cli/tests/drain.rs, and the Unreleased CHANGELOG bullet. No production code, key or schema changed. Criterion 3 is unmet as written, because 8 files changed, not 1. Criterion 4 cannot pass at job_usd 60 without the test edits, since config.rs tests assert job_usd == 50.0. The athena-data tests and the boundary-scan policy test pass. I did not run the athena-core and athena-cli tests I edited.
